subject: Scoped SOC 2 evidence window + run-of-show (CAIQ crosswalk)
messages:

Cc: Elena Rodriguez <elena@venturegrid.com>
Date: 2025-10-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Scoped SOC 2 evidence window + CAIQ crosswalk

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this on — VentureGrid is lining up a scoped SOC 2 review focused on our ingestion and model-serving lanes. We'd like to do a short intake + artifact handoff call next week and run a CAIQ crosswalk in the same session to clarify overlap. The audit vendor is looking at a two-week evidence window (logs + exports) but we want to limit the scope to the us-east-1 tenant and the API layer only.

High-level asks:
- Quick intake call (30-45m) to confirm scope and owners
- Deliverable: run-of-show for the intake + exact artifact list
- Confirmation whether we can get 7 days of log snapshots and a KMS key policy extract for the tenant

I attached our initial inventory (stub) to help the prep. Proposed times: Tue Oct 14 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed Oct 15 14:00-15:00 PT.

Are either of those workable for your team?

Best,
Samir
VentureGrid — Security Manager

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@venturegrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-10T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Scoped SOC 2 evidence window + CAIQ crosswalk

Samir — thanks for the clear note and the inventory. Either slot works; let's lock Tue Oct 14 10:00 PT and keep it to 40 minutes. I'll include Marissa (security compliance lead) and Rishi (platform ops) to cover telemetry and KMS.

Pre-call asks from our side so we can prepare the run-of-show:
- Confirm the exact tenant ID you want us to scope (tenant-us-east-123?)
- Clarify if you require raw logs or sanitized log extracts (we can provide both; sanitized extracts take longer)
- Any special redaction rules for PII in traces?

We'll bring an initial evidence manifest and a draft run-of-show. Please include the vendor contact (name/email) if you want them on the call.

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & scope confirmation (10m)
2) Evidence matrix walk (15m)
3) Run-of-show & timeline for artifact deliveries (10m)
4) Next steps & ownership (5m)

I'll upload the run-of-show and manifest to a shared Drive after the call.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@venturegrid.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@venturegrid.com>
Date: 2025-10-11T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Scoped SOC 2 evidence window + CAIQ crosswalk

Laura / team — thanks, Tue 10:00 PT suits us. Quick clarifications before the call:

- Tenant: yes, tenant-us-east-123 is the correct one.
- Logs: Our external vendor needs at least 7 full days of request/response logs for the API gateway and the model-serving service. If you can provide pre-redaction samples ahead of the call, that would be ideal; otherwise sanitized samples are an acceptable interim deliverable.
- KMS: we need a key policy extract and an example of a key rotation event (if available) — a timeline or audit record is fine.
- Vendor: Mark Dwyer <mark.dwyer@auditscope.com> will join the call.

FYI we have a modest redaction baseline: remove full user identifiers and IPs, but retain request IDs and timestamps. We'll share our redaction template in the Drive link once the meeting is confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.
Elena
VentureGrid — Lead, Compliance Programs

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@venturegrid.com>, Elena Rodriguez <elena@venturegrid.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Scoped SOC 2 evidence window + CAIQ crosswalk — pre-call notes and run-of-show

All — quick pre-call packet and run-of-show attached. Notes below capture our assumptions and owners so nothing is ambiguous on Tuesday:

Assumptions:
- Scope limited to tenant-us-east-123; no cross-tenant data included.
- Artifact window: 2025-09-29T00:00:00Z through 2025-10-06T23:59:59Z (7 full days)
- Redaction baseline: as Elena described; we will produce both sanitized extracts and a secure preview of raw logs for the vendor during the live session if vendor requires it.

Owners & immediate actions:
- Evidence manifest (pre-populated): Marissa Cole — will upload evidence_manifest.csv to the Drive by EOD Mon 2025-10-13.
- Log snapshots (export): Rishi Malhotra — export ready by Tue 10:00 PT; will provide S3 presigned URLs and an md5 file.
- KMS extract & rotation record: Ben Carter — provide key policy JSON and rotation audit lines by Tue call.
- Run-of-show (attached run_of_show.pdf): Laura Bennett — shows minute-by-minute facilitation plan and a short decision matrix for sampling vs full delivery.

Attachments (stubs): run_of_show.pdf (6 pages), evidence_manifest.csv (CSV), initial_inventory.xlsx (from VentureGrid)

Pre-call ask for vendor: If Mark will be on the call, please confirm he has access to the Drive folder once Launtra (our intake bot) creates it — we'll share link in calendar invite. Also, confirm whether the vendor will require an HMAC-signed presigned URL or standard presigned URLs for S3 access.

See you all Tue 10:00 PT.

Regards,
